title: A local override on a CharacterStyleRange
concept: Both runs apply the Emphasis character style; the second range sets PointSize directly on itself, and that local value wins over the style.

annotations.note: First run: applies Emphasis with no overrides, so its size comes from the style (PointSize 12).
Second run: applies the same Emphasis style but carries PointSize="24" on the range itself; the run-level value wins, so this text shapes at 24 pt.
